page.overview:
Who is Hanna Ackerson?

Her first appearance is in Masahiko Nakahira's Super Street Fighter II: Cammy Gaiden manga, albeit designed differently, Nakahira can be credited for her initial concept. Hanna also appears in the prologue story from Street Fighter IV.
